I have hands-on experience in building efficient, scalable, and user-friendly mobile applications that seamlessly integrate features like REST APIs, local storage, OCR, TTS, and AI/ML-based functionalities. My goal is to continuously evolve as a developer by creating impactful, innovative applications that solve real-world problems.
